species.en: More than two hundred species of bird have been recorded on the island.
species.zh: 这座岛上已记录到两百多种鸟类。

organism.en: Tiny organisms in the soil help to break down dead plants.
organism.zh: 土壤中的微小生物体有助于分解枯死的植物。

creature.en: Many deep-sea creatures produce their own light in the dark water.
creature.zh: 许多深海生物在黑暗的水中自己发光。

mammal.en: Bats are the only mammals capable of true flight.
mammal.zh: 蝙蝠是唯一能够真正飞行的哺乳动物。

reptile.en: Most reptiles lay eggs and rely on the sun to keep them warm.
reptile.zh: 大多数爬行动物产卵,并依靠阳光保持体温。

amphibian.en: Frogs and other amphibians are very sensitive to pollution in the water.
amphibian.zh: 青蛙和其他两栖动物对水污染非常敏感。

primate.en: Humans share many social behaviours with other primates, such as chimpanzees.
primate.zh: 人类与黑猩猩等其他灵长类动物有许多相同的社会行为。

rodent.en: Rats and other rodents can spread disease through their waste.
rodent.zh: 老鼠和其他啮齿动物可以通过排泄物传播疾病。

marsupial.en: A marsupial carries its young in a pouch on the front of its body.
marsupial.zh: 有袋动物把幼崽放在身体前部的育儿袋中。

vertebrate.en: Fish were the first vertebrates to appear on Earth.
vertebrate.zh: 鱼类是地球上最早出现的脊椎动物。

invertebrate.en: Invertebrates such as worms and insects make up most animal species.
invertebrate.zh: 蠕虫和昆虫等无脊椎动物占动物物种的大多数。

insect.en: Without insects to carry pollen, many plants could not reproduce.
insect.zh: 如果没有昆虫传粉,许多植物将无法繁殖。

beetle.en: Some species of beetle can damage entire forests within a few years.
beetle.zh: 某些种类的甲虫能在几年内毁掉整片森林。

butterfly.en: The butterfly travels thousands of kilometres from Canada to Mexico each autumn.
butterfly.zh: 这种蝴蝶每年秋天从加拿大飞越数千公里到达墨西哥。

moth.en: Unlike butterflies, most moths are active during the night.
moth.zh: 与蝴蝶不同,大多数飞蛾在夜间活动。

mosquito.en: Only the female mosquito bites people, as it needs blood for its eggs.
mosquito.zh: 只有雌蚊才叮人,因为它需要血液来产卵。

termite.en: Termites build huge nests that stay at a constant temperature.
termite.zh: 白蚁建造巨大的巢穴,巢内温度保持恒定。

spider.en: Most spiders catch their food in webs made of very strong silk.
spider.zh: 大多数蜘蛛用极其坚韧的丝织成的网捕捉食物。

parasite.en: The parasite lives inside the fish and slowly weakens it.
parasite.zh: 这种寄生虫生活在鱼体内,使它慢慢变得虚弱。

predator.en: Sharp eyesight helps the bird to escape from its main predators.
predator.zh: 敏锐的视力帮助这种鸟逃避主要的捕食者。

prey.en: Owls can locate their prey by sound alone, even in total darkness.
prey.zh: 即使在完全黑暗中,猫头鹰也能仅凭声音确定猎物的位置。

prey.en: These large cats prey mainly on deer and wild pigs.
prey.zh: 这些大型猫科动物主要捕食鹿和野猪。

carnivore.en: Lions and other large carnivores need very large areas in which to hunt.
carnivore.zh: 狮子和其他大型食肉动物需要很大的狩猎范围。

herbivore.en: Elephants are herbivores that eat up to 150 kilos of plants a day.
herbivore.zh: 大象是食草动物,每天吃多达 150 公斤的植物。

omnivore.en: As an omnivore, the bear eats both meat and a wide range of plants.
omnivore.zh: 作为杂食动物,熊既吃肉,也吃各种植物。

scavenger.en: Vultures are scavengers that feed on animals already dead.
scavenger.zh: 秃鹫是以已死动物为食的食腐动物。

herd.en: A herd of elephants can travel long distances in search of water.
herd.zh: 一群大象可以长途跋涉寻找水源。

flock.en: A large flock of geese flies over the valley every autumn.
flock.zh: 每年秋天都有一大群大雁飞越这个山谷。

swarm.en: A swarm of locusts can destroy a whole field of crops in hours.
swarm.zh: 一群蝗虫能在几小时内毁掉整片庄稼。

colony.en: Ants live in a large colony with a single queen.
colony.zh: 蚂蚁生活在只有一只蚁后的大群体中。

colony.en: The British established their first colony in North America in the 1600s.
colony.zh: 英国人在 17 世纪在北美建立了第一个殖民地。

nest.en: Both parents help to build the nest and feed the young birds.
nest.zh: 父母双方都帮忙筑巢和喂养幼鸟。

burrow.en: Rabbits live in an underground burrow that protects them from predators.
burrow.zh: 兔子住在地下洞穴里,可以躲避捕食者。

burrow.en: Some animals burrow deep into the sand to escape the desert heat.
burrow.zh: 有些动物深挖沙洞来躲避沙漠的炎热。

hive.en: Bees return to the hive and use a special dance to share information.
hive.zh: 蜜蜂回到蜂巢后,用一种特殊的舞蹈传递信息。

den.en: The female bear gives birth in a den during the winter months.
den.zh: 母熊在冬季的兽穴中产崽。

habitat.en: The destruction of its forest habitat has put the animal at great risk.
habitat.zh: 森林栖息地遭到破坏,使这种动物面临巨大风险。

ecosystem.en: The loss of a single species can affect the entire ecosystem.
ecosystem.zh: 一个物种的消失可能影响整个生态系统。

ecology.en: She studied the ecology of the river before the dam was built.
ecology.zh: 她在大坝建成之前研究了这条河的生态。

biodiversity.en: Tropical forests have the highest level of biodiversity on land.
biodiversity.zh: 热带森林拥有陆地上最高的生物多样性。

food-chain.en: Chemicals become more concentrated as they move up the food chain.
food-chain.zh: 化学物质沿食物链向上传递时,浓度会越来越高。

food-web.en: Removing one animal from a food web can have unexpected effects.
food-web.zh: 从食物网中移除一种动物可能产生意想不到的影响。

niche.en: Each species in the forest occupies its own ecological niche.
niche.zh: 森林中的每个物种都占据着自己的生态位。

symbiosis.en: Corals live in symbiosis with tiny plants that provide them with food.
symbiosis.zh: 珊瑚与为其提供食物的微小植物共生。

mutualism.en: Mutualism occurs when two species both benefit from living closely together.
mutualism.zh: 当两个物种紧密生活在一起并都受益时,就形成了互利共生。

camouflage.en: The insect's green colour provides excellent camouflage among the leaves.
camouflage.zh: 这种昆虫的绿色在树叶间提供了极好的伪装。

mimicry.en: Mimicry allows some harmless snakes to look like dangerous ones.
mimicry.zh: 拟态使一些无害的蛇看起来像危险的蛇。

instinct.en: Young turtles move towards the sea by instinct as soon as they hatch.
instinct.zh: 小海龟一孵化出来,就凭本能爬向大海。

behaviour.en: Researchers filmed the animals to study their behaviour in the wild.
behaviour.zh: 研究者拍摄这些动物,以研究它们在野外的行为。

territory.en: Male birds sing loudly to defend their territory against rivals.
territory.zh: 雄鸟大声鸣叫,保卫领地不受对手侵犯。

migrate.en: Many birds migrate south to avoid the cold winter months.
migrate.zh: 许多鸟南迁以躲避寒冷的冬季。

migration.en: The long migration of these birds takes them across the Sahara Desert.
migration.zh: 这些鸟的长途迁徙要飞越撒哈拉沙漠。

hibernate.en: Some bears hibernate for up to seven months in very cold regions.
hibernate.zh: 在非常寒冷的地区,有些熊冬眠长达七个月。

hibernation.en: During hibernation, the animal's heart rate drops to a fraction of its normal level.
hibernation.zh: 冬眠期间,这种动物的心率会远低于正常水平。

breed.en: Sea birds return to these islands each year to breed.
breed.zh: 海鸟每年回到这些岛屿繁殖。

breed.en: Farmers developed this breed of sheep for its soft wool.
breed.zh: 农民培育这种羊的品种是为了获取柔软的羊毛。

reproduce.en: Some plants can reproduce without producing any seeds at all.
reproduce.zh: 有些植物完全不产生种子也能繁殖。

reproduction.en: Warm temperatures are needed for the successful reproduction of many reptiles.
reproduction.zh: 许多爬行动物要在温暖的气温下才能成功繁殖。

mate.en: Male peacocks display their bright feathers to attract a mate.
mate.zh: 雄孔雀展示鲜艳的羽毛来吸引配偶。

mate.en: Some birds mate for life and return to the same nest each year.
mate.zh: 有些鸟终生配对,每年回到同一个巢。

offspring.en: Sea turtles do not care for their offspring after laying their eggs.
offspring.zh: 海龟产卵后不照顾后代。

larva.en: The larva feeds on leaves until it is ready to change into an adult.
larva.zh: 幼虫以树叶为食,直到准备好变为成虫。

hatch.en: The eggs hatch after about three weeks, depending on the temperature.
hatch.zh: 根据温度不同,这些蛋大约三周后孵化。

embryo.en: The embryo develops inside the egg for about twenty days.
embryo.zh: 胚胎在蛋内发育约二十天。

evolution.en: Darwin's theory of evolution changed the way people viewed the natural world.
evolution.zh: 达尔文的进化论改变了人们看待自然界的方式。

natural-selection.en: Through natural selection, the fish developed colours that matched the sea floor.
natural-selection.zh: 通过自然选择,这些鱼进化出了与海底相近的颜色。

adaptation.en: Thick fur is an adaptation that allows the animal to survive severe cold.
adaptation.zh: 厚皮毛是一种适应,使这种动物能够在严寒中生存。

gene.en: A single gene may determine the colour of the bird's feathers.
gene.zh: 单个基因可能决定这种鸟的羽毛颜色。

genetic.en: Genetic tests show that the two populations separated about a million years ago.
genetic.zh: 基因检测显示,这两个种群大约在一百万年前分开。

mutation.en: A random mutation may give an animal a small advantage over others.
mutation.zh: 随机突变可能让某只动物比其他个体略占优势。

inherit.en: Children inherit half of their genes from each parent.
inherit.zh: 孩子从父母双方各继承一半的基因。

trait.en: Long necks are a useful trait for animals feeding on tall trees.
trait.zh: 对于以高大树木为食的动物来说,长脖子是一种有用的特征。

ancestor.en: Modern horses evolved from a much smaller ancestor that lived in forests.
ancestor.zh: 现代马是从一种生活在森林中、体型小得多的祖先进化而来的。

descendant.en: Today's dogs are all descendants of ancient wolves.
descendant.zh: 如今的狗都是古代狼的后裔。

extinct.en: The dodo became extinct within a century of the arrival of humans.
extinct.zh: 人类到来后不到一个世纪,渡渡鸟就灭绝了。

extinction.en: Hundreds of plants are now in danger of extinction due to habitat loss.
extinction.zh: 由于栖息地丧失,现在有数百种植物面临灭绝的危险。

endangered.en: The law protects endangered animals and the places where they live.
endangered.zh: 法律保护濒危动物及其栖息之地。

threatened.en: Many threatened birds have begun to recover since hunting was banned.
threatened.zh: 自禁猎以来,许多受威胁的鸟类已开始恢复。

poaching.en: Poaching remains a serious problem for elephants in parts of Africa.
poaching.zh: 在非洲部分地区,偷猎仍然是大象面临的严重问题。

conservation.en: Conservation groups are working to protect the last areas of old forest.
conservation.zh: 保护组织正在努力保护最后的原始森林区。

sanctuary.en: The bird sanctuary provides a safe place for thousands of migrating geese.
sanctuary.zh: 这个鸟类保护区为数千只迁徙的大雁提供了安全的地方。

captivity.en: The pandas bred in captivity will later be released into the wild.
captivity.zh: 这些圈养繁殖的大熊猫之后将被放归野外。

domesticate.en: People began to domesticate sheep and goats around ten thousand years ago.
domesticate.zh: 人类大约一万年前开始驯化绵羊和山羊。

wildlife.en: The national park is famous for its rich and varied wildlife.
wildlife.zh: 这个国家公园以丰富多样的野生动物闻名。

fauna.en: The island's fauna includes several species found nowhere else.
fauna.zh: 这座岛的动物群中有几种在其他地方都找不到的物种。

flora.en: The local flora changes greatly as you climb higher up the mountain.
flora.zh: 随着海拔升高,当地的植物群变化很大。

feather.en: Scientists have found dinosaur fossils with clear signs of feathers.
feather.zh: 科学家发现了带有明显羽毛痕迹的恐龙化石。

beak.en: The shape of a bird's beak depends on the kind of food it eats.
beak.zh: 鸟喙的形状取决于它吃的食物种类。

claw.en: The animal uses its sharp claws to dig for insects under the ground.
claw.zh: 这种动物用锋利的爪子在地下挖昆虫。

fin.en: Fish use their fins to steer and to balance in the water.
fin.zh: 鱼用鳍在水中控制方向和保持平衡。

gill.en: Fish take oxygen from the water through their gills.
gill.zh: 鱼通过鳃从水中获取氧气。

scale.en: The snake's skin is covered with small, dry scales.
scale.zh: 蛇的皮肤上覆盖着干燥的小鳞片。

scale.en: The scale of the damage only became clear several weeks later.
scale.zh: 损失的规模几周后才变得清晰。

tusk.en: Elephants use their tusks to dig for water and to strip bark from trees.
tusk.zh: 大象用长牙挖水和剥树皮。

horn.en: Both male and female animals of this species have long curved horns.
horn.zh: 这个物种的雄性和雌性都长有弯曲的长角。

fur.en: The animal's thick fur protects it from temperatures far below zero.
fur.zh: 这种动物厚厚的皮毛使它能抵御远低于零度的低温。

antenna.en: Insects use their antennae to touch and smell things around them.
antenna.zh: 昆虫用触角触碰和嗅闻周围的东西。

venom.en: Snake venom is now used in the development of some medicines.
venom.zh: 蛇毒现在被用于开发一些药物。

venomous.en: Only a small number of the country's snakes are venomous.
venomous.zh: 该国只有少数蛇是有毒的。

dinosaur.en: The dinosaur fossils were found in rocks about seventy million years old.
dinosaur.zh: 这些恐龙化石是在约七千万年前的岩石中发现的。

ape.en: Chimpanzees and other apes are able to use simple tools.
ape.zh: 黑猩猩和其他猿类能够使用简单的工具。

gorilla.en: A gorilla family usually consists of one adult male, several females and their young.
gorilla.zh: 一个大猩猩家庭通常由一只成年雄性、几只雌性和幼崽组成。

chimpanzee.en: A chimpanzee can learn to use a stick to catch insects.
chimpanzee.zh: 黑猩猩能学会用树枝捕捉昆虫。

baboon.en: Baboons live in large groups with a strict order of rank.
baboon.zh: 狒狒生活在有严格等级的大群体中。

rhinoceros.en: The rhinoceros has been hunted almost to extinction for its horn.
rhinoceros.zh: 犀牛因其角遭到捕杀,几近灭绝。

hippopotamus.en: The hippopotamus spends most of the day in water to keep cool.
hippopotamus.zh: 河马白天大部分时间待在水中以保持凉爽。

crocodile.en: The female crocodile carries her newly hatched young to the water in her mouth.
crocodile.zh: 雌鳄鱼用嘴把刚孵化的幼崽衔到水里。

leopard.en: The leopard often drags its food up into a tree for safety.
leopard.zh: 豹常把食物拖到树上以保安全。

kangaroo.en: A young kangaroo stays in its mother's pouch for about six months.
kangaroo.zh: 小袋鼠在母亲的育儿袋中待大约六个月。

koala.en: The koala feeds almost entirely on the leaves of eucalyptus trees.
koala.zh: 考拉几乎完全以桉树叶为食。

otter.en: The otter uses stones as tools to open shellfish.
otter.zh: 水獭用石头作工具打开贝类。

beaver.en: A beaver can build a dam that changes the flow of a whole river.
beaver.zh: 河狸能筑起改变整条河流流向的水坝。

tortoise.en: The giant tortoise can live for well over a hundred years.
tortoise.zh: 巨型陆龟可以活一百多岁。

turtle.en: Each year the turtles return to lay their eggs on this beach.
turtle.zh: 每年海龟都回到这片海滩产卵。

lizard.en: Some lizards can lose their tails to escape from an attacker.
lizard.zh: 有些蜥蜴能断尾逃脱攻击者。

chameleon.en: A chameleon can move each of its eyes in a different direction.
chameleon.zh: 变色龙的两只眼睛能分别朝不同方向转动。

toad.en: Unlike frogs, a toad usually has dry skin covered in small lumps.
toad.zh: 与青蛙不同,蟾蜍的皮肤通常干燥,布满小疙瘩。

ostrich.en: The ostrich cannot fly, but it can run at very high speed.
ostrich.zh: 鸵鸟不会飞,但能高速奔跑。

penguin.en: Male emperor penguins keep the eggs warm during the long Antarctic winter.
penguin.zh: 在漫长的南极冬季,雄帝企鹅负责为蛋保暖。

pelican.en: The pelican catches fish in the large pouch under its beak.
pelican.zh: 鹈鹕用喙下的大囊袋捕鱼。

owl.en: Soft feathers allow the owl to fly almost silently at night.
owl.zh: 柔软的羽毛让猫头鹰夜间飞行时几乎悄无声息。

woodpecker.en: A woodpecker uses its strong beak to search for insects under tree bark.
woodpecker.zh: 啄木鸟用强壮的喙在树皮下寻找昆虫。

crane.en: The crane performs an elaborate dance during the breeding season.
crane.zh: 鹤在繁殖季节会跳一种精心编排的舞蹈。

crane.en: A large crane lifted the sections of the bridge into position.
crane.zh: 一台大型起重机把桥的各部分吊到了位。

finch.en: Scientists noticed that the beak of each finch suited its particular diet.
finch.zh: 科学家注意到,每只雀的喙都适合它特定的食物。

crow.en: Crows have been seen using tools to reach food in narrow spaces.
crow.zh: 有人观察到乌鸦使用工具获取狭窄空间里的食物。

sparrow.en: The number of house sparrows has fallen sharply in many European cities.
sparrow.zh: 在许多欧洲城市,家麻雀的数量急剧下降。

pigeon.en: Pigeons were once used to carry messages over long distances during wars.
pigeon.zh: 鸽子曾在战争中被用来远距离传递消息。

fowl.en: Early farmers kept fowl for both their meat and their eggs.
fowl.zh: 早期农民饲养家禽,既为吃肉也为取蛋。

locust.en: A locust can eat its own weight in food every day.
locust.zh: 蝗虫每天能吃下相当于自身体重的食物。

wasp.en: Some types of wasp lay their eggs inside the bodies of other insects.
wasp.zh: 有些种类的黄蜂把卵产在其他昆虫体内。

dragonfly.en: A dragonfly can fly backwards and stay still in the air.
dragonfly.zh: 蜻蜓能向后飞,也能悬停在空中。

caterpillar.en: The caterpillar eats large amounts of leaves before forming a hard case.
caterpillar.zh: 毛毛虫吃下大量树叶后,才形成坚硬的外壳。

silkworm.en: The Chinese kept the secret of the silkworm for many centuries.
silkworm.zh: 中国人把蚕的秘密保守了许多个世纪。

earthworm.en: Earthworms improve the soil by creating small tunnels through the ground.
earthworm.zh: 蚯蚓在地下钻出小隧道,从而改良土壤。

worm.en: Birds use their sharp eyesight to find a worm in the grass.
worm.zh: 鸟用敏锐的视力在草丛中寻找蠕虫。

mollusc.en: Snails and octopuses both belong to the group known as molluscs.
mollusc.zh: 蜗牛和章鱼都属于软体动物这一类群。

cub.en: A lion cub stays with its mother for about two years.
cub.zh: 狮子幼崽和母亲一起生活大约两年。

pupa.en: The insect stays inside the pupa for about two weeks before it appears.
pupa.zh: 这种昆虫在蛹内待大约两周才出来。

carrion.en: Vultures have a strong sense of smell that helps them to find carrion.
carrion.zh: 秃鹫嗅觉灵敏,这有助于它们找到腐肉。

tentacle.en: The jellyfish catches small fish with its long tentacles.
tentacle.zh: 水母用长长的触手捕捉小鱼。

spine.en: The human spine supports the head and protects important nerves.
spine.zh: 人的脊柱支撑头部,并保护重要的神经。

spine.en: Hard spines on the plant prevent animals from eating its leaves.
spine.zh: 这种植物上坚硬的刺防止动物吃它的叶子。

hump.en: A camel stores fat in its hump to use when food is scarce.
hump.zh: 骆驼把脂肪储存在驼峰里,供食物短缺时使用。

hide.en: Early people used animal hide to make warm clothes and shelters.
hide.zh: 早期的人们用兽皮制作保暖的衣物和住所。

webbed.en: Ducks have webbed feet that help them to swim quickly.
webbed.zh: 鸭子有蹼足,这有助于它们快速游泳。

genus.en: Lions and tigers belong to the same genus of large cats.
genus.zh: 狮子和老虎同属大型猫科动物中的一个属。

carnivorous.en: Carnivorous plants obtain extra nutrients by trapping small insects.
carnivorous.zh: 食肉植物通过捕捉小昆虫获取额外的养分。

herbivorous.en: Herbivorous dinosaurs needed huge amounts of plants to stay alive.
herbivorous.zh: 食草恐龙需要大量植物才能存活。

omnivorous.en: Pigs are omnivorous and will eat almost anything they can find.
omnivorous.zh: 猪是杂食的,几乎什么都吃。

predatory.en: Some predatory fish hunt in groups to catch larger animals.
predatory.zh: 一些捕食性鱼类成群捕猎,以捕捉较大的动物。

nocturnal.en: Most bats are nocturnal and sleep in caves during the day.
nocturnal.zh: 大多数蝙蝠是夜行性的,白天在洞穴里睡觉。

aquatic.en: Many aquatic plants absorb nutrients directly from the surrounding water.
aquatic.zh: 许多水生植物直接从周围的水中吸收养分。

gregarious.en: These gregarious birds nest close together in very large groups.
gregarious.zh: 这些群居的鸟聚集成很大的群体,紧挨着筑巢。

monogamous.en: Only a small number of mammals are thought to be monogamous.
monogamous.zh: 人们认为只有少数哺乳动物是一夫一妻的。

endemic.en: Many of the plants on the islands are endemic and grow nowhere else.
endemic.zh: 岛上的许多植物是当地特有的,在其他地方都不生长。

endemic.en: Malaria is endemic in many tropical parts of the world.
endemic.zh: 疟疾在世界许多热带地区是地方性疾病。

hereditary.en: Some forms of the disease are hereditary and pass from parent to child.
hereditary.zh: 这种疾病的某些类型是遗传的,由父母传给孩子。

spawn.en: Salmon swim back up the same river to spawn each year.
spawn.zh: 鲑鱼每年逆流游回同一条河产卵。

peck.en: The young chicks peck at the shell until it breaks open.
peck.zh: 小鸡不停地啄蛋壳,直到把它啄破。

proliferate.en: Bacteria can proliferate quickly in warm and wet conditions.
proliferate.zh: 细菌在温暖潮湿的环境中能迅速繁殖。

propagate.en: Gardeners often propagate this plant by cutting and replanting its stems.
propagate.zh: 园丁常通过扦插茎来繁殖这种植物。

subsist.en: In winter, the deer subsist on bark and small branches.
subsist.zh: 冬天,鹿靠树皮和小树枝维持生存。

strain.en: A new strain of the virus has spread rapidly through the region.
strain.zh: 这种病毒的一个新品种已在该地区迅速传播。

strain.en: Rapid population growth has put a great strain on the water supply.
strain.zh: 人口快速增长给供水带来了巨大压力。

secrete.en: Glands in the skin secrete a substance that protects against infection.
secrete.zh: 皮肤中的腺体分泌一种防止感染的物质。

secretion.en: The plant's sticky secretion traps insects that land on its leaves.
secretion.zh: 这种植物的黏性分泌物能粘住落在叶子上的昆虫。

assimilate.en: Plants assimilate nitrogen from the soil through their roots.
assimilate.zh: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收氮。

assimilate.en: Immigrants often assimilate into local society within a few generations.
assimilate.zh: 移民往往在几代之内融入当地社会。

morphology.en: The morphology of the bones suggests that the animal walked on two legs.
morphology.zh: 骨骼的形态表明这种动物用两条腿行走。

microscope.en: The invention of the microscope allowed scientists to see bacteria for the first time.
microscope.zh: 显微镜的发明使科学家第一次看到了细菌。

darwinism.en: Darwinism was fiercely debated by scientists and religious leaders in the 1860s.
darwinism.zh: 19 世纪 60 年代,科学家和宗教领袖就达尔文学说展开了激烈争论。

endangered-species.en: The tiger is an endangered species, with very few left in the wild.
endangered-species.zh: 老虎是濒危物种,野外所剩无几。

natural-habitat.en: Zoos cannot fully recreate the natural habitat of these large animals.
natural-habitat.zh: 动物园无法完全重现这些大型动物的自然栖息地。

bird-of-prey.en: The eagle is a large bird of prey with extremely sharp eyesight.
bird-of-prey.zh: 雕是一种视力极其敏锐的大型猛禽。

hawk.en: A hawk circled high above the field, looking for small animals.
hawk.zh: 一只鹰在田野上空高高盘旋,寻找小动物。

sniff.en: Dogs sniff the air to detect the smell of other animals.
sniff.zh: 狗嗅空气以察觉其他动物的气味。

eagle.en: The eagle builds a huge nest of sticks at the top of a tall tree.
eagle.zh: 雕在高树顶上用树枝搭建巨大的巢。

cage.en: Keeping large birds in a small cage can cause them great stress.
cage.zh: 把大型鸟类关在小笼子里会让它们承受巨大压力。

chick.en: Each chick must leave the nest within about two months of hatching.
chick.zh: 每只雏鸟都要在孵化后大约两个月内离巢。

bait.en: Scientists used fish as bait to attract the sharks to their cameras.
bait.zh: 科学家用鱼作诱饵,把鲨鱼吸引到相机前。

crawl.en: Newly hatched turtles crawl across the sand towards the sea.
crawl.zh: 刚孵化的小海龟爬过沙滩奔向大海。

botany.en: Her interest in botany began with the wild flowers near her home.
botany.zh: 她对植物学的兴趣始于家附近的野花。

vegetation.en: The vegetation on the northern side of the hill is much thicker.
vegetation.zh: 山丘北侧的植被要茂密得多。

shrub.en: Low shrubs are the main form of plant life in the dry hills.
shrub.zh: 矮小的灌木是干燥山丘上主要的植物类型。

bush.en: Small birds often hide their nests deep inside a thick bush.
bush.zh: 小鸟常把巢藏在茂密灌木丛的深处。

vine.en: The vine climbs up the trunks of tall trees to reach the light.
vine.zh: 藤蔓沿着高树的树干向上攀爬,以获取阳光。

moss.en: Moss grows well on wet rocks in the shade of the forest.
moss.zh: 苔藓在森林树荫下的湿石上长得很好。

fern.en: Ferns reproduce by means of spores rather than seeds.
fern.zh: 蕨类通过孢子而不是种子繁殖。

fungus.en: The fungus spreads through the roots and slowly kills the tree.
fungus.zh: 这种真菌在根部蔓延,慢慢杀死树木。

mushroom.en: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous and can be fatal if eaten.
mushroom.zh: 有些野生蘑菇有毒,吃了可能致命。

seed.en: Birds carry the seeds of many plants over long distances.
seed.zh: 鸟类把许多植物的种子带到很远的地方。

seedling.en: The young seedlings need protection from frost during their first year.
seedling.zh: 幼苗在第一年需要防霜保护。

sprout.en: The first green leaves sprout from the seeds within a few days.
sprout.zh: 几天之内,种子就发芽长出第一批绿叶。

germinate.en: Some seeds will germinate only after they have been through a fire.
germinate.zh: 有些种子只有经过火烧才会发芽。

stem.en: Water travels up the stem from the roots to the leaves.
stem.zh: 水沿着茎从根部输送到叶子。

trunk.en: The age of a tree can be found by counting the rings in its trunk.
trunk.zh: 通过数树干上的年轮可以知道树的年龄。

bark.en: The bark of this tree was used to make medicine for fevers.
bark.zh: 这种树的树皮曾被用来制作退烧药。

twig.en: Birds gather twigs and dry grass to build their nests.
twig.zh: 鸟收集细枝和干草来筑巢。

petal.en: Bright petals attract insects to the centre of the flower.
petal.zh: 鲜艳的花瓣把昆虫吸引到花朵中心。

pollen.en: Bees carry pollen from one flower to another as they feed.
pollen.zh: 蜜蜂采食时把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花。

pollinate.en: Many fruit trees depend on bees to pollinate their flowers.
pollinate.zh: 许多果树依靠蜜蜂为花朵授粉。

pollination.en: Without pollination by insects, many fruit crops would produce far less food.
pollination.zh: 如果没有昆虫授粉,许多果树的产量会大幅减少。

nectar.en: Hummingbirds feed on nectar from flowers using their long, thin beaks.
nectar.zh: 蜂鸟用又长又细的喙吸食花蜜。

blossom.en: Cherry blossom attracts large crowds of visitors to the park each spring.
blossom.zh: 樱花每年春天吸引大批游客来到公园。

blossom.en: Apple trees blossom in spring, and the fruit is picked in autumn.
blossom.zh: 苹果树春天开花,秋天摘果。

bloom.en: This rare flower blooms for just a single night each year.
bloom.zh: 这种珍稀的花每年只开一夜。

photosynthesis.en: Plants use photosynthesis to turn sunlight and water into energy.
photosynthesis.zh: 植物通过光合作用把阳光和水转化为能量。

chlorophyll.en: Chlorophyll gives plants their green colour and absorbs energy from the sun.
chlorophyll.zh: 叶绿素使植物呈现绿色,并吸收太阳能量。

deciduous.en: Deciduous trees lose all of their leaves during the autumn.
deciduous.zh: 落叶树在秋季会落光所有树叶。

evergreen.en: Evergreen trees keep their leaves throughout the entire year.
evergreen.zh: 常绿树全年都保留树叶。

conifer.en: A conifer has narrow leaves that help it to survive cold winters.
conifer.zh: 针叶树的叶子细长,有助于它度过寒冬。

timber.en: Ships in the past were built almost entirely from timber.
timber.zh: 过去的船几乎完全用木材建造。

lumber.en: Companies cut down trees in the northern forests to produce lumber.
lumber.zh: 公司砍伐北部森林的树木来生产木材。

deforestation.en: Deforestation has increased the risk of flooding in many tropical countries.
deforestation.zh: 森林砍伐增加了许多热带国家的洪水风险。

afforestation.en: Afforestation programmes aim to create new forests on empty land.
afforestation.zh: 植树造林项目旨在在荒地上营造新的森林。

agriculture.en: Agriculture still employs most of the population in the region.
agriculture.zh: 农业仍然雇用了该地区的大多数人口。

agricultural.en: New machines led to a rapid increase in agricultural production.
agricultural.zh: 新机器使农业产量迅速增长。

farming.en: Farming began in this area about eight thousand years ago.
farming.zh: 这一地区的农业大约始于八千年前。

crop.en: Rice is the main crop grown in the flooded fields of the south.
crop.zh: 水稻是南方水田种植的主要农作物。

crop.en: A poor crop can leave small farmers with too little to eat.
crop.zh: 歉收可能让小农户没有足够的食物。

cereal.en: Wheat and other cereals provide much of the world's food.
cereal.zh: 小麦和其他谷物提供了世界上大部分的食物。

grain.en: Farmers store their grain in dry buildings to prevent it from rotting.
grain.zh: 农民把谷物储存在干燥的建筑里,防止腐烂。

grain.en: Each grain of sand on the beach was once part of a larger rock.
grain.zh: 海滩上的每一粒沙子都曾是一块大岩石的一部分。

wheat.en: Bread made from wheat became the main food in much of Europe.
wheat.zh: 小麦做的面包成为欧洲大部分地区的主食。

barley.en: Barley grows well in cool climates and is often used to make beer.
barley.zh: 大麦在凉爽气候中长得很好,常用来酿啤酒。

maize.en: Maize was first grown in Central America thousands of years ago.
maize.zh: 玉米最早于数千年前在中美洲种植。

soybean.en: The soybean is grown mainly for animal feed and for cooking oil.
soybean.zh: 大豆主要用作动物饲料和食用油原料。

harvest.en: Heavy rain just before the harvest can destroy a whole year's work.
harvest.zh: 收获前的大雨可能毁掉一整年的劳动成果。

harvest.en: Farmers usually harvest the grapes by hand in late summer.
harvest.zh: 农民通常在夏末用手采摘葡萄。

plough.en: The invention of the iron plough made it easier to farm heavy soil.
plough.zh: 铁犁的发明使耕种黏重的土壤变得更容易。

plough.en: Farmers used oxen to plough their fields before tractors were invented.
plough.zh: 拖拉机发明之前,农民用牛犁地。

irrigation.en: Irrigation has allowed crops to be grown in very dry parts of the country.
irrigation.zh: 灌溉使该国非常干旱的地区也能种植庄稼。

irrigate.en: Farmers use water from the river to irrigate their fields in summer.
irrigate.zh: 夏天,农民用河水灌溉田地。

fertiliser.en: Too much fertiliser can run off the land and harm nearby rivers.
fertiliser.zh: 过多的化肥会从土地上流失,危害附近的河流。

fertile.en: The fertile soil along the river produced good crops every year.
fertile.zh: 沿河肥沃的土壤每年都能产出好庄稼。

barren.en: After years of overuse, the land became barren and could not be farmed.
barren.zh: 经过多年过度使用,这片土地变得贫瘠,无法耕种。

soil.en: Rich soil holds both water and the nutrients that plants need.
soil.zh: 肥沃的土壤既能保水,也含有植物所需的养分。

pesticide.en: Some pesticides kill helpful insects as well as those that damage crops.
pesticide.zh: 有些农药不仅杀死危害庄稼的昆虫,也杀死益虫。

herbicide.en: The herbicide kills unwanted plants without harming the wheat.
herbicide.zh: 这种除草剂能杀死杂草,但不会伤害小麦。

pest.en: Birds help farmers by eating insect pests that damage crops.
pest.zh: 鸟类吃掉危害庄稼的害虫,从而帮助农民。

weed.en: Weeds compete with crops for sunlight, water and space.
weed.zh: 杂草与庄稼争夺阳光、水分和空间。

livestock.en: Most of the land is used for raising livestock such as cows and sheep.
livestock.zh: 大部分土地用于饲养牛羊等家畜。

cattle.en: Herds of cattle were once driven long distances across the plains to market.
cattle.zh: 牛群曾被长途驱赶,穿越平原去往市场。

dairy-farm.en: Most dairy farms in the area produce milk for local cheese makers.
dairy-farm.zh: 该地区的大多数奶牛场为当地奶酪生产商供奶。

ranch.en: The family owns a large cattle ranch in the south of the state.
ranch.zh: 这家人在该州南部拥有一个大牧场。

graze.en: Sheep graze on the hills during the summer and return to the valley in autumn.
graze.zh: 羊夏天在山上吃草,秋天回到山谷。

pasture.en: The farmer moves the cows to fresh pasture every few days.
pasture.zh: 农民每隔几天把牛转移到新的牧场。

plantation.en: Many workers on the sugar plantation lived in very poor conditions.
plantation.zh: 糖料种植园的许多工人生活条件非常差。

greenhouse.en: Tomatoes can be grown all year round in a heated greenhouse.
greenhouse.zh: 番茄可以在加热的温室里全年种植。

genetically-modified.en: Some people are worried about the safety of genetically modified food.
genetically-modified.zh: 有些人担心转基因食品的安全性。

famine.en: Millions of people died during the famine that followed the failed harvest.
famine.zh: 歉收后的饥荒导致数百万人死亡。

food-security.en: Climate change poses a serious risk to food security in many countries.
food-security.zh: 气候变化对许多国家的粮食安全构成严重风险。

botanical.en: The botanical garden contains plants collected from all over the world.
botanical.zh: 这座植物园收藏着来自世界各地的植物。

inorganic.en: Plants absorb inorganic substances from the soil and turn them into food.
inorganic.zh: 植物从土壤中吸收无机物,并把它们转化为养分。

foliage.en: The thick foliage of the trees hides the birds from their enemies.
foliage.zh: 茂密的树叶把鸟藏了起来,使其不被天敌发现。

bud.en: New buds appear on the branches as soon as the weather warms.
bud.zh: 天气一转暖,枝头就长出新芽。

shoot.en: Pandas feed mainly on the young shoots and leaves of bamboo.
shoot.zh: 大熊猫主要以竹子的嫩枝和叶子为食。

stalk.en: Corn plants have tall stalks that can reach three metres in height.
stalk.zh: 玉米植株的茎秆很高,可达三米。

bough.en: The heavy snow broke a large bough from the old oak tree.
bough.zh: 大雪压断了老橡树上一根粗大的树枝。

husk.en: The outer husk of the rice is removed before it is eaten.
husk.zh: 稻米的外壳要去掉才能食用。

shell.en: The hard shell protects the soft body of the animal inside.
shell.zh: 坚硬的外壳保护着里面动物柔软的身体。

peel.en: The peel of the fruit contains oils that keep insects away.
peel.zh: 这种水果的果皮含有能驱赶昆虫的油脂。

peel.en: Workers peel the bark from the trees by hand.

log.en: The heavy logs were floated down the river to the sawmill.
log.zh: 沉重的原木顺河漂到锯木厂。

spore.en: The wind can carry spores a long way from the parent plant.
spore.zh: 风能把孢子带到离母株很远的地方。

herb.en: Many traditional medicines are made from wild herbs.
herb.zh: 许多传统药物由野生草本植物制成。

reed.en: Ancient Egyptians made a type of paper from a tall water reed.
reed.zh: 古埃及人用一种高大的水生芦苇造纸。

orchid.en: Each type of orchid depends on a particular insect for pollination.
orchid.zh: 每一种兰花都依赖特定的昆虫授粉。

cactus.en: A cactus stores water in its thick stem during long dry periods.
cactus.zh: 仙人掌在漫长的干旱期把水分储存在粗壮的茎中。

sequoia.en: The giant sequoia can grow to more than eighty metres in height.
sequoia.zh: 巨型红杉可以长到八十多米高。

rubber.en: Natural rubber comes from a liquid produced by certain tropical trees.
rubber.zh: 天然橡胶来自某些热带树木产生的液体。

starch.en: Potatoes are rich in starch, which provides the body with energy.
starch.zh: 土豆富含淀粉,能为身体提供能量。

glucose.en: Plants produce glucose as a source of energy during photosynthesis.
glucose.zh: 植物在光合作用中产生葡萄糖作为能量来源。

fermentation.en: Fermentation turns the sugar in grapes into alcohol.
fermentation.zh: 发酵把葡萄中的糖转化为酒精。

ripe.en: The fruit changes from green to red when it is ripe.
ripe.zh: 这种水果成熟时由绿变红。

prolific.en: Rabbits are prolific breeders and can quickly take over new areas.
prolific.zh: 兔子繁殖力极强,能迅速占领新地区。

infertile.en: Much of the land is infertile and can support only a few sheep.
infertile.zh: 大部分土地贫瘠,只能养少量的羊。

arable.en: Only a small part of the country's land is arable.
arable.zh: 该国只有一小部分土地可以耕种。

husbandry.en: Good animal husbandry helps to keep farm animals healthy.
husbandry.zh: 良好的畜牧管理有助于保持家畜健康。

horticulture.en: Students of horticulture learn how to grow fruit, vegetables and flowers.
horticulture.zh: 学习园艺的学生学习如何种植水果、蔬菜和花卉。

hydroponics.en: Hydroponics allows vegetables to be grown in water without any soil.
hydroponics.zh: 水培法使蔬菜可以在水中生长,完全不需要土壤。

manure.en: Farmers spread animal manure on the fields to improve the soil.
manure.zh: 农民把动物粪肥撒在田里来改良土壤。

insecticide.en: Spraying insecticide can also harm birds that feed on the insects.
insecticide.zh: 喷洒杀虫剂也会伤害以这些昆虫为食的鸟类。

fodder.en: Farmers grow oats as fodder for their horses during the winter.
fodder.zh: 农民种燕麦作为马冬天的饲料。

hay.en: Dried grass is stored as hay to feed the cattle in winter.
hay.zh: 干草被储存起来,冬天用来喂牛。

granary.en: The Romans built a large granary to store wheat for the city.
granary.zh: 罗马人建造了一座大粮仓,为城市储存小麦。

sorghum.en: Sorghum can grow in hot, dry areas where other cereals fail.
sorghum.zh: 高粱能在其他谷物难以生长的炎热干旱地区生长。

tractor.en: The arrival of the tractor reduced the number of farm workers needed.
tractor.zh: 拖拉机的出现减少了所需的农场工人数量。

intensive.en: Intensive farming produces more food but can damage the soil.
intensive.zh: 集约化耕作产量更高,但可能损害土壤。

hedge.en: The old hedge between the fields provides a home for small birds.
hedge.zh: 田地之间的老树篱为小鸟提供了栖身之所。

hedge.en: Farmers grow several different crops to hedge against the risk of bad weather.
hedge.zh: 农民种植多种作物,以对冲恶劣天气的风险。

nutrient.en: Soil loses important nutrients when the same crop is grown every year.
nutrient.zh: 每年种同一种作物,土壤就会流失重要的营养物。

phosphate.en: Phosphate from farms can cause harmful changes in lakes and rivers.
phosphate.zh: 农场流出的磷酸盐可能对湖泊和河流造成有害影响。

yeast.en: Yeast is added to the mixture to make the bread rise.
yeast.zh: 在面团中加入酵母,面包才能发起来。

pine.en: Tall pine forests cover the mountains in the north of the country.
pine.zh: 该国北部的山上覆盖着高大的松树林。

mill.en: The old flour mill on the river is now a small museum.
mill.zh: 河边的老面粉厂现在是一座小博物馆。

mill.en: Thousands of people came to the city to work in the cotton mills.
mill.zh: 成千上万的人来到这座城市,在棉纺厂工作。

palm.en: Local people use the leaves of the palm to make baskets and roofs.
palm.zh: 当地人用棕榈叶编篮子和盖屋顶。

forestry.en: Forestry provides many jobs in the sparsely populated north of the country.
forestry.zh: 林业为该国人口稀少的北部提供了许多工作岗位。

sow.en: Farmers sow the seeds in spring, just after the last frost.
sow.zh: 农民在春天最后一场霜过后播种。

reap.en: Farmers who invest in better soil will reap the benefits for years.
reap.zh: 投资改良土壤的农民多年都能从中获益。

shepherd.en: A shepherd moved the sheep up into the hills every summer.
shepherd.zh: 每年夏天,牧羊人把羊赶到山上。

cart.en: Vegetables were taken to market by horse and cart until the 1920s.
cart.zh: 直到 20 世纪 20 年代,蔬菜还靠马车运到市场。
